item_short_desc: The SABRE Mighty Discreet Pepper Spray Black contains 16 bursts and has a 12-foot (4-meter) range.
description: The SABRE Mighty Discreet Pepper Spray Black contains 16 bursts and has a 12-foot (4-meter) range. This pepper spray is 40 percent smaller than traditional pepper sprays and has an ultra-compact design with a twist top safety. Comes with a key ring and a snap clip.
